description: Exactly what the main window's page calls. The shell's own commands (view, act, load_set) need no entry: a local page may call an app's commands while it declares no app manifest. The page opens question sets with the dialog plugin's open; data-tauri-drag-region starts a drag and, on a double click, toggles maximize (Tauri's drag.js); the devtools shortcut exists only in debug builds. A page that calls anything else adds it here.
